_comment: Alevi Connect API (Node.js + Prisma/PostgreSQL) - Pterodactyl egg. Container kokune repo icerigini yukleyin (packages/ + services/).
name: Alevi Connect API
author: hi@sonalis.com.tr
description: Alevi Connect Node.js API (Express + Prisma + PostgreSQL + Redis opsiyonel). DATABASE_URL dis Postgres ister; Pterodactyl MySQL ile calismaz.
startup: cd services/api && PORT={{SERVER_PORT}} npm run prisma:migrate && PORT={{SERVER_PORT}} node dist/src/server.js

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -e
apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq git > /dev/null
npm --prefix packages/config install
npm --prefix packages/config run build
npm --prefix packages/contracts install
npm --prefix packages/contracts run build
cd services/api
npm ci
npm run build
echo "Alevi API kurulumu tamam. Sunucu Variables sekmesinden secretlari girin."

variables.name: Database URL
variables.description: Dis PostgreSQL baglanti adresi. Ornek: postgresql://kullanici:sifre@host:5432/alevi?schema=public (Supabase/Neon/kendi sunucun). Pterodactyl MySQL OLMAZ.

variables.name: Redis URL
variables.description: Opsiyonel. Bos birakilirsa API Redissiz calisir (ozellikler kisitlanabilir). Ornek: redis://:sifre@host:6379

variables.name: CORS Origins
variables.description: Virgulle ayrilmis izinli origin listesi. Ornek: https://sonalis.com.tr

variables.name: JWT Access Secret
variables.description: En az 32 karakter rastgele secret (openssl rand -hex 32).

variables.name: JWT Refresh Secret
variables.description: Access secretten FARKLI, en az 32 karakter rastgele secret.

variables.name: Sensitive Data Key
variables.description: 64 hex karakter (32 byte). Uret: openssl rand -hex 32. Kaybedersen sifreli alanlar okunamaz, yedegini sakla.
